messages.en:
We're on the cusp of a
new year! May all your
dreams come true this
year! Happy New Year!

The first sunrise of the
year quietly creeps over
the city. This year should
be another good one.

Remember the snowman you
made when you were small?
There wasn't enough snow,
so it was mostly dirt. Ha!

Did the groundhog show
his face today? There IS
a groundhog in that odd
commune you live in, yes?

I saw a bird feeding her
baby today. It reminded
me of your childhood, only
with less regurgitation.

Today a big chunk of snow
fell on my head. I was so
relieved it wasn't the
work of a huge bird.

After my evening bath, I
like to look at the cherry
blossoms in the twilight
and think...

You must promise to walk
with me again by the
cherry blossoms in bloom.

The kitchen wall still
has the marks we used to
track your height. We
really must paint it soon.

Today was so warm that
the ice cream man made
his rounds. I had to chase
him down, though.

The sound of rain falling
on windows surrounds me.
For some reason, it takes
me back to my youth.

The other night your dad
and I walked along the
river and saw fireflies...
Summer is near.

There were so many
fireflies out last night
that they looked like a
million stars. Lovely.

There was a fireworks
show in town today. I ate
a cloud of cotton candy
the size of my head.

Wake up, sleepyhead! Time
to start your morning
workout. I'll only tell you
this once: FEEL THE BURN!

I saw a shooting star in
the summer sky. My wish? 
Well, that's a secret, of
course! Tee hee!

According to the calendar,
fall starts in September,
but it's still too hot to
put the fans away.

All of the sudden, I can
hear crickets and
grasshoppers. Fall snuck
up on us again.

Remember when I got that
bob and you kept calling
me "mushroom head"?

There's a chill in the air
that smells like fall. I
want to drink apple cider
and eat pumpkin soup.

After doing yard work, I
like to burn the leaves.
It gives off the sweet
smell of accomplishment.

If you stand still outside
you can hear it... Winter's
footsteps, the sound of
falling leaves.

I shall write my greeting
cards today. All of them!
But first, I need a snack.

I thought I saw you
coming toward me through
the fog. Then I realized
it was just a rock.

Report cards, crafts, and
pictures of you. These
are my treasures and
they always will be.

It's Mother's Day, so why
am I writing you? You
should be writing ME!

Your mom's not the only
writer in this family!
Do you remember what day
it is today? Hint, hint!

Don't forget to write
your dad. He's been a
great dad to you! Don't
tell him I said that!

Guess what?! The editor
of Pie Monthly asked me
to be this month's
cover model!

A tree fell onto the
house and crushed it!
We lost everything!
Just kidding.

It smells like snow and
hot chocolate! It's
that time of year again!
The holidays!

Are you coming home for
the holidays? Don't worry,
we found the hamster and
gave it a proper burial.

I thank my lucky stars
every day for bringing
you into my life.
Thank you, my dear!

On your first birthday,
you smashed cake into
your hair. You looked so
pleased with yourself.
